attempts.summary: Bootstrapped a fresh 3-member etcd v3.7.1 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (RHEL9) since no etcd existed previously, loaded it with application keys, then simulated node3's permanent, unrecoverable loss by wiping its data dir and removing its member ID from the cluster. Added a brand-new member identity on node3, started it in 'existing' cluster-state so it joined and resynced via raft, restoring a healthy 3-member cluster with all original keys intact. Completed the mandatory per-node restart protocol: captured boot-id baselines, restarted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time via systemctl reboot, confirmed each boot-id changed, and verified full cluster health/membership/key data after each restart.
